AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

In this role, you'll coordinate the tenders, vendor registrations, and documentation requests that let institutional and business customers say yes to AMBOSS. You'll sit at the center of the company, working closely with Sales and pulling in expertise from IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Security, and Engineering to get every request answered accurately and on time.

Every tender we win and every questionnaire we complete well helps bring AMBOSS into more hospitals, health systems, and medical schools: directly supporting our mission of empowering medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

You'll start with structured, recurring processes and grow into someone institutional customers and internal teams alike rely on to get things done.

You will:

  • Support tender and procurement processes, coordinating the company information, documentation, and internal contributions they require.

  • Complete and maintain customer vendor registrations and onboarding requirements in procurement and vendor-management systems.

  • Coordinate documentation and information requests from Sales and from prospective or existing customers.

  • Maintain commonly requested company documents and keep current, approved versions easily accessible.

  • Track requests, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding contributions from internal stakeholders.

  • Identify and coordinate with the right subject-matter experts across IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams.

  • Support completion of customer questionnaires covering company information, technology, privacy, AI, security, and compliance topics.

  • Help document and improve internal processes so recurring commercial and customer-assurance requests can be handled more efficiently.

You bring:

  • First professional experience in operations, administration, sales support, customer support, project coordination, or another structured cross-functional role; relevant internship or working-student experience also welcome.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience managing multiple requests, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1) and German (C1).

  • Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate.

  • Comfort reaching out to colleagues across departments and following up on outstanding information.

  • Nice to have: previous exposure to tenders, procurement portals, vendor onboarding, customer questionnaires, or documentation management.

You enjoy:

  • Structured, detail-oriented work and keeping track of many moving pieces at once.

  • Coordinating with people across different teams to get to an answer.

  • Learning unfamiliar terminology and processes quickly.

  • Gradually taking ownership of recurring workflows and making them run more smoothly.

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

title: Pflegepädagog:in als Educational Engagement Representative bei Novaheal
description: Hallo, wir sind AMBOSS und wir suchen eine:n Educational Engagement Representative für Novaheal, um unsere Lern-App in Pflegeschulen und Bildungseinrichtungen in den gesamten deutschsprachigen Raum zu bringen. Warum AMBOSS? AMBOSS ist der Copilot für den medizinischen Alltag. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Fachkräfte bei der Fortbildung sowie bei klinischen Entscheidungen, um stets die bestmögliche Patientenversorgung zu gewährleisten. Unser Team vereint Fürsorge, innovative Ideen und modernste KI-basierte Medizintechnologie. Gegründet wurde AMBOSS 2012 von Ärztinnen und Ärzten, die genau das Tool entwickeln wollten, das ihnen im Studium und in der Klinik gefehlt hat. Seitdem sind wir auf über 600 Mitarbeitende gewachsen und in mehr als 180 Ländern aktiv, vor allem in Deutschland und den USA. Unsere Büros befinden sich in Berlin, Köln, New York, Cagliari und Kapstadt. Du möchtest mehr über unsere Kultur erfahren? Schau dir unser Video an. Über Novaheal bei AMBOSS Für den Bereich der Pflegeausbildung ist die AMBOSS NOVAHEAL GmbH seit 2024 Teil der AMBOSS SE. NOVAHEAL wurde von erfahrenen Pflegefachpersonen entwickelt und bietet eine breite Palette an Lerninhalten, die gezielt auf die Anforderungen der Pflegeausbildung zugeschnitten sind. Gemeinsam stehen wir für eine werteorientierte Unternehmenskultur und verbinden die Leidenschaft für innovative Bildung im Gesundheitswesen mit einem klaren Ziel: die Pflegebranche – und insbesondere die Pflegeausbildung – nachhaltig zu stärken und zu transformieren. Als Teil unseres Teams im B2B Relationship Management bist du die treibende Kraft hinter der Einführung und erfolgreichen Implementierung unserer Lern-App in Institutionen des Gesundheitswesens und trägst aktiv zum Ausbau unserer Kooperationen bei. Durch deine Erfahrung aus Pflege, Praxisanleitung, Wissenschaft und/oder Pädagogik sprichst du die Sprache unserer Vertragspartner und kannst ihre Herausforderungen nicht nur nachvollziehen, sondern auch gezielt Lösungen anbieten. Warum ist diese Position spannend für dich? Du bist Pflegepädagoge, Pflegepädagogin oder in dem Bereich tätig, hast eine Leidenschaft für Bildung und möchtest deine Expertise nutzen, um in einem dynamischen, zukunftsorientierten Bereich tätig zu werden? Als Mitarbeiter:in von NOVAHEAL by AMBOSS im Schwerpunkt Relationship Management kombinierst du dein Wissen aus der Pflege und Pädagogik mit der Strategie, Pflegefachpersonen, Pädagog:innen und Entscheider:innen in der Gesundheitsbranche unsere App lösungsorientiert näherzubringen. Mit deinem Verständnis für die spezifischen Herausforderungen in der Pflegeausbildung treibst du nicht nur unser Wachstum voran, sondern leistest auch einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Digitalisierung in der Ausbildung zukünftiger Pflegefachpersonen. Deine Aufgaben: Kundengewinnung & Beratung: Du präsentierst unsere Lernapp authentisch, überzeugend und legst den Grundstein für eine langfristige Beziehung zu Institutionen und Entscheider:innen in der Gesundheitsbranche. Je nach Zielgruppe führst du Bedarfsanalysen durch oder erstellst effektive Präsentationen und One-Pager, die auf die Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen der jeweiligen Ausbildungsinstitution abgestimmt sind. Akkurates Tracking und Reporting: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten in unserem CRM-System (Hubspot) und erstellst präzise Forecasts, um den Überblick über deine Pipeline und Erfolge zu behalten. Betreuung und Kooperation: Du begleitest Kund:innen über den gesamten Prozess in der Auseinandersetzung mit NOVAHEAL hinweg und bist Ansprechpartner:in für eine nachhaltige und erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit und Implementierung. Bedürfnisorientierte Lösungen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kund:innen zusammen, erkennst ihre individuellen Anforderungen und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Teamarbeit: Du bringst deine Expertise und Erfahrungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing- und Produktteam ein, um unser Angebot kontinuierlich zu verbessern und noch zielgerichteter auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Partner:innen auszurichten. Nachhaltige Erfolge: Du fungierst als qualitativ hochwertiger Vertragspartner durch empathisches, lösungsorientiertes und kluges Handeln und das, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Weiterentwicklung: Du reflektierst bestehende Prozesse und arbeitest eng mit unserem Data Team und Sales Operations zusammen, um Nutzungsdaten zu analysieren und auszuwerten. Du repräsentierst NOVAHEAL und AMBOSS auf Veranstaltungen, Messen und Konferenzen und übernimmst aktives Networking zur Steigerung der Markenbekanntheit. Deine Fähigkeiten: Ein pflegepädagogischer, pflegewissenschaftlicher oder vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Erste Erfahrungen in Leitungsfunktionen (z.B. Schulleitung, PDL, stellv. Schulleitung) sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Verständnis für die Strukturen und Abläufe in Pflegeschulen und Gesundheitsakademien. Fundierte Kenntnisse über die generalistische Pflegeausbildung, ihre Finanzierung und den dazugehörigen Rahmenlehrplan, um unsere Zielgruppe optimal zu verstehen oder die Bereitschaft, dir diese anzueignen. Werteorientiertes Handeln, Zuverlässigkeit und eine sehr stark ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung. Affinität zu Anschaffungs-/ Vertriebs- und Implementierungsthemen, wobei erste Erfahrungen in diesem Kontext ein Pluspunkt sind. Empathische Kommunikationsweise und gutes Stakeholder-Management sowie eine strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. Dafür sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich. Eine proaktive Arbeitshaltung und Begeisterung für Teamarbeit. Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert zu arbeiten, inklusive exzellenter Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten. Du bist lernbegierig und hast Lust dich in neuen Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln. Du hast Lust ab und zu zu Kundenterminen oder Konferenzen zu reisen. Du bist bereit, eine Vollzeitstelle mit einer Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden pro Woche zu übernehmen oder anzustreben. Das bieten wir dir: Eine umfassende, auf dich (zeitlich) abgestimmte Einarbeitung, die dich optimal auf deinen neuen Aufgabenbereich vorbereitet. Einen sinnstiftenden Job, mit dem du messbaren Impact in der Pflegebranche erzielst. Attraktive Vergütungsmodelle mit Bonusoptionen, die deine Leistung wertschätzen. Ein dynamisches und wertebasiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und einem engagierten und offenen Team. 100% Remote-Tätigkeit mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und die Option, an unseren Standorten in Berlin oder Köln zu arbeiten wenn du möchtest. Berlin benefits: AMBOSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen. 🌴 Erholung & Freizeit (30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, einen AMBOSS-Feiertag, ein persönlicher Purpose Day und mehr) 🥙 Verpflegung & Komfort (Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland, mit der Möglichkeit, jederzeit aus unseren Büros in Berlin, Köln, Sardinien oder Kapstadt zu arbeiten) 🏃 Gesundheit & Mobilität (Urban Sports Club – M-Plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland-Ticket und mehr) Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefit-Pakete: http://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt ein starker Motor für Innovation und Fortschritt ist. Deshalb engagieren wir uns für ein inklusives, respektvolles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer oder kultureller Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder geschlechtlicher Identität – wertgeschätzt werden und die gleichen Chancen erhalten, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten. 💙 Wir heißen Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen herzlich willkommen, uns bei unserer Mission zu unterstützen: medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei zu stärken und die bestmögliche Versorgung zu gewährleisten. 🩺 Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich, dich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment. In this role you will: Own the identification, assessment, and documentation of risks across key domains together with the Risk team, business stakeholders, and control owners, so lemon.markets can make informed decisions and maintain a resilient risk profile as the business grows. Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions. Maintain and improve our internal control framework, risk register, and operational risk procedures in close collaboration with the Head of Risk and cross-functional stakeholders, so our framework remains effective, usable, and aligned with business and regulatory needs. Contribute to risk topics across operational and non-financial risk, financial risk, ICAAP, ILAAP, third-party risk, and security-related assessments, so we can build a broader and more integrated view of risk across the organisation. Draft clear business and technical requirements for process improvements, tooling enhancements, and automation initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Operations, so we can increase risk transparency, improve reporting quality, and reduce manual work. Collaborate with auditors, supervisory stakeholders, and internal teams on evidence gathering, incident analysis, root-cause identification, and follow-up actions, so lemon.markets stays audit-ready and continues to improve the effectiveness of its risk management practices. You’ll be successful in this role if you: You bring strong hands-on experience in Risk Management within FinTech, banking, audit, consulting, or a similarly regulated environment, with broad exposure across multiple risk domains. You have solid knowledge of operational and non-financial risk, internal controls, risk governance, and risk assessments, plus a good understanding of financial risk topics such as credit, market, liquidity, ICAAP, and ILAAP. You are familiar with the relevant regulatory foundations, including MaRisk, DORA, CRR, IFR, and applicable EBA and ESMA guidelines; knowledge of MiFID, MaComp, and WpHG is a strong plus. You are confident working with risk management tools, structured documentation, reporting, testing, and validation, and you are comfortable translating requirements into pragmatic process or tooling improvements. You communicate clearly in English, and bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context. You are hands-on, analytical, and collaborative: you enjoy building, improving, and following through, work well across functions, and stay effective in fast-moving or sometimes ambiguous environments. How we take care of you 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more and leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites, or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations, as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply. If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply. You have any questions? title: Founding Customer Support Engineer
description: The mission: comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures , along with top European investors. comstruct builds AI agents for construction. Our platform automates the entire flow from the bill of quantities to the fully verified invoice: RFQs and supplier matching, bid comparison and negotiation, framework contracts and orders, digital delivery notes, invoice verification and sustainability reporting. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us bring this to an industry that still runs most of it by hand. About the role 🦺 As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day. When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work. You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built. The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself. What you will be building 🏗️ Own inquiries end-to-end: Our customers run some of the largest construction sites in Europe. When something breaks, it's real: trucks, deliveries, invoices, deadlines. Automate support with our own agents: We sell AI agents; support is a function where we also deploy them internally. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins. Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you. Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear. Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you. Report what matters: Time to first response, time to resolution on integration breaks, and how many recurring issue classes you eliminated. You consistently share where we stand with Customer Value Engineers and the wider team. What we’re looking for ✨ 1 - 2 years in a technical, customer-facing role: Customer Success or Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, Implementation, TAM or similar. You're comfortable in APIs, logs, SQL and data flows and can debug across systems you didn't build. You know when an issue is the integration, the data or the product. You can explain a failed integration to an engineer and to a non-technical customer stakeholder, and both walk away clear. You want to understand how the product works under the hood instead of treating it as a black box. You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel. You are native in German and fluent in English . Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch. What we offer A path into building: This role is a launchpad. As you learn how customers use the product and where it breaks, you can grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and build the fixes and features yourself. Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan. Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CTO Dominik Brosch , plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC. Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware. Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company. Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca, Italy and Portugal. title: Produktionsmitarbeiter Cube & Unterverteilung (m/w/d)
description: Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Die Rolle In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort. Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen. Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde. Deine Aufgaben Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren. Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel. Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse. Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden. Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation. Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf. Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen. Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik. Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um. Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug. Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik. Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen. Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: Quality Minded: Du arbeitest genau und prüfst dein Ergebnis, bevor es das Haus verlässt – ein Fehler in der Produktion wird beim Kunden teuer. Hands-on: Du packst an, arbeitest zügig und behältst auch bei hohen Stückzahlen den Blick fürs Detail. Structured Thinker: Du organisierst deinen Arbeitsplatz und dein Material so, dass Abläufe reibungslos laufen. Die Rolle

In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort.

Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen.

Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut.

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde.

description: Einleitung Enterprise Solution Architect (gn) Schwerpunkt EAM-Plattform und Governance Wie oft im Leben bekommt man die Chance, Enterprise Architecture nicht zu reparieren, sondern von null aufzubauen? Die meisten EAM-Rollen beginnen mit einem Erbe: ein Tool, das vor Jahren jemand anderes gekauft hat, ein Repository mit Stand von vorgestern, eine Community, die sich aus Pflicht trifft. Diese Rolle beginnt mit einem leeren Blatt. Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die Holding, die alle Geschäftsbereiche steuert, baut dabei Enterprise Architecture Management als eigenständige Funktion auf, mit eigenem Tooling, eigenen Prozessen und konzernweiter Geltung. Tool-Auswahl, Metamodell, Governance: nichts davon ist entschieden. Das wird deine Entscheidung. Solche Konstellationen gibt es selten und sie halten nicht lange. In zwei Jahren ist die neue IT-Organisation gesetzt, und wer dann kommt, arbeitet in Strukturen, die jemand anderes gebaut hat. Jetzt ist der Moment, in dem man sie baut. Worum es geht Enterprise Architecture scheitert selten an fehlenden Frameworks. Sie scheitert daran, dass niemand das Repository pflegt, das Tool nicht mit den Quellsystemen spricht und die Architektur-Community nach dem dritten Meeting einschläft. Diese Rolle verhindert genau das. Du baust die Grundlage, auf der EAM in diesem Konzern funktioniert. Prozesse, die Menschen tatsächlich befolgen. Eine Plattform, die ihre Daten automatisiert bezieht, statt dass jemand sie abtippt. Deine Aufgaben Du definierst, wie Architekturarbeit im Konzern abläuft: Prozessmodelle, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Beschreibungen und Anforderungskataloge. Du wählst das EAM-Tool aus, von der Marktsondierung über die Ausschreibung bis zur Entscheidung, und verantwortest danach Implementierung und Konfiguration. Du konzipierst die Anbindung an Konfigurationsdatenbank, Service-Management und Cloud-Umgebungen, damit das Repository aktuell bleibt, ohne dass jemand es manuell nachführt. Du entwickelst das Architektur-Metamodell weiter, wenn Geschäft oder Technologie es verlangen und misst die Reife der Prozesse regelmäßig gegen Industriestandards. Du probierst neue Methoden aus, etwa Capability Maps oder Wertstromanalysen, und entscheidest, was davon in diesen Konzern passt. Du sorgst für Betrieb und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform, inklusive Rollen und Zugriffskonzepten und definierst Kennzahlen für Datenqualität. Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Formate, pflegst die Dokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen. AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren. Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen. Du hast bereits Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen. Du hast Erfahrung in einem Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software. Du kannst offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren , Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen. Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst Ownership für das Ergebnis . Du besitzt ein starkes Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln. title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. raw.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar

  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies.

raw.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About Langdock

Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology and adoption. We build a secure, model-agnostic AI platform that helps companies put AI to work across their entire organization. From chat and agents to integrations, workflows, and our API, we give teams the tools to augment and automate their work.

We apply the same ambition internally. We want to be the most productive company in the world, and that means continuously improving how we work, not simply adding more people to existing processes.

 

About the Role

Help Langdock understand what drives growth, and engineer the data foundations and systems that make those answers reliable.

We are hiring our first dedicated RevOps Engineer (Data & BI) to give Revenue Operations the capacity to own both commercial data architecture and the processes connecting our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams.

At Langdock, commercial teams are technical and dedicate ~30% of their time to building. This means frontline workflows are designed and maintained close to the people using them. RevOps shifts focus toward more complex cross-functional challenges: architecting our commercial data model, delivering robust BI, and engineering seamless inter-team processes.

Your ownership of the core data domain will create the room to scale growth projects, account handovers, CRM standards, and renewal/expansion architectures.

The role combines two core focus areas:

~70% Applied Data & BI: Connect commercial, product, and billing data, build reliable models and reporting, and investigate questions that shape commercial decisions. You will own initiatives from initial business questions through modeling, validation, and analysis, helping teams act on the results.

~30% Cross-Functional RevOps Systems & Processes: Help design and improve how teams collaborate - from lead lifecycle stages and Sales-to-CS handovers to renewal, expansion, and billing processes. Working alongside the functional teams, you will clarify responsibilities, define required data touchpoints, and turn agreements into working, automated systems.

Langdock moves fast. This split provides a starting baseline, while priorities will evolve as our product portfolio and commercial organization scale. You will also take on high-impact special projects around growth initiatives and commercial operations.

 

What you will do

  • Architect shared commercial data & BI: Connect customer, product, and revenue data across systems (CRM, billing, product databases, and GTM tools); maintain consistent core metrics; and provide reliable, actionable reporting.

  • Build in-house revenue & billing logic: Own and refine our revenue tracking, billing data reconciliation, and lifecycle metrics so leadership and commercial teams can rely on one source of truth.

  • Support commercial planning and measurement: Provide clean definitions and data models to inform company goals, quotas, commission/compensation structures, forecasting, and account development.

  • Investigate growth drivers: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, and Engineering to explore key commercial questions, uncover pipeline/expansion bottlenecks, and validate hypotheses.

  • Optimize GTM funnels & lifecycle workflows: Define clear cross-team handoffs (e.g., Lead-to-Opportunity, Sales-to-CS, renewals, and expansions), ensuring clean CRM hygiene and minimal friction.

  • Leverage AI and modern automation internally: Use Langdock agents, automation tools, and CRM integrations to eliminate repetitive manual operational tasks and feed internal learnings back into our product.

 

What we are looking for

  • You write clean, performant SQL with confidence and have hands-on experience combining data from disparate, sometimes messy sources into resilient relational models.

  • You treat data with an engineering mindset: you don't just write ad-hoc queries, you build sustainable data workflows, test edge cases, validate outputs, and document your work so others can build on top of it.

  • You think commercially and are curious about what makes businesses grow. You understand B2B SaaS mechanics and distinguish vanity dashboards from data that drives commercial decisions.

  • You have practical experience with CRM systems (such as HubSpot), modern billing data, and automation tools.

  • You build with AI. You have hands-on experience using AI and automation tools to solve real problems and streamline operational work.

  • You can listen to ambiguous business questions from sales, CS, or leadership, translate them into clear technical requirements, and communicate analytical findings with clarity.

 

Our Values

  • Calm urgency. We move fast without chaos. We stay calm, fix what matters, and avoid unnecessary noise. We focus on solutions rather than complaints and make sure sleep, health, and sports keep our decision-making sharp.

  • Ambitious execution. We love building fast and with ownership. We aim to be the most productive company in the world. Learning, shipping, and improving bring us joy. Everyone is expected to ask questions, take initiative, and deliver reliably.

  • Caring ownership. We care deeply: about each other, customers, and the world around us. We act with empathy, sincerity, and long-term thinking. And we have fun along the way while spending time in the office together.

 

The Environment

We work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves—gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. Health is not separate from work here; it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

 

Compensation & Leveling

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

 

When you apply

When you apply, we would love to see an example of a data model, analysis, or workflow automation you've built. Tell us what problem it solved, how it works, and what you learned.

 

Next steps

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to meet you.

Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots. Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences. You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist. Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools Experience in or with the defence sector, e.g. in the Bundeswehr (including reserve service), at a defence company, in federal IT or at NATO, and a deep understanding of how defence organisations buy and run IT. Eligible and willing to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung under the SÜG, Ü2 or higher). An existing clearance is a strong plus. Preferred : experience in the German defence market, e.g. at a system integrator or consultancy, or working on RFPs and public tenders. title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users . The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints. Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models. Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im klassischen sowie agilen IT-Projektmanagement. Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit Software-Entwicklungsteams. Idealerweise Kenntnisse / Erfahrungen in der Energiewirtschaft oder SaaS Bereich. Analytisches und strukturiertes Vorgehen sowie Überblick fürs „große Ganze“ – auch bei hoher Projektkomplexität. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und unternehmerisches Denken an der Schnittstelle zwischen externen und internen Stakeholdern. Fähigkeit zur Risikobewertung und proaktivem Risikomanagement. title: Field & Campaign Manager DACH (m/w/d)
description: Stadtwerke, Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber stehen mitten in der digitalen Transformation, und epilot ist mit der Energy-XRM-Plattform ihr Partner auf diesem Weg. Damit wir in DACH weiter wachsen, wollen wir genau die Unternehmen erreichen, die uns noch nicht kennen. Branchen-Messen, Fachkonferenzen und persönliche Begegnungen sind dafür unser wichtigster Hebel, denn in der Energiewirtschaft entstehen Geschäftsbeziehungen im direkten Gespräch. Diese Momente verbinden wir mit ABM, Kampagnen und enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, damit aus einem guten Gespräch echte Pipeline wird. epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die gemeinsam Produkte und Dienstleistungen in der Energiewelt erbringen. Innerhalb unserer Cloud-Welt bieten wir ein großes Partner-Netzwerk, das durch unsere Community stetig wächst. Das erwartet dich Du planst und führst Field- und ABM-Programme für priorisierte Zielsegmente in DACH, mit klaren Zielen für Leads, Lead-Qualität und Pipeline. Für unsere strategischen Zielaccounts verantwortest du ABM strategisch und operativ, von der Account-Auswahl bis zur koordinierten Multi-Channel-Ansprache. Kampagnen über E-Mail, LinkedIn, Sales-Mailings, Paid und Retargeting steuerst du so, dass Leads entstehen und sich durch den Funnel bewegen. Die Inhalte setzt du gemeinsam mit Product Marketing und Freelancer:innen um. Du wählst externe Messen, Konferenzen und Fachevents danach aus, ob sie neue Zielaccounts erreichen. Vorab-Ansprache, Lead-Erfassung und Nachbereitung liegen bei dir. Mit Side Events baust du schon vor dem eigentlichen Event persönliche Bindung zu Neu- und Bestandskund:innen auf. Du trackst MQLs, SQLs und Pipeline-Beitrag in HubSpot und lieferst belastbare Reportings. Gemeinsam mit unserem Partner Manager treibst du gemeinsame Kampagnen, Messestände und Networking-Events voran. Wirkung & Zusammenarbeit Du denkst in Zahlen (Meetings, Demos, Opportunities) und machst sichtbar, wie viel Pipeline unsere Events wirklich beeinflussen. Events sind dein Ankerpunkt. Über ABM, Webinare und Sales-Mailings verstärkst du sie gezielt, statt sie isoliert zu betrachten. In enger Abstimmung mit Sales sorgst du dafür, dass deine Programme direkt auf die Geschäftsziele einzahlen. Dazu gehören Lead-Übergabe, Nurturing und die Conversion zur Opportunity. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Event Managerin (interne, kundenzentrierte Events), unserem Growth & Campaign Manager, unserer Product Marketing Managerin und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit Fokus auf Demand Generation, ABM oder Field Marketing. Du weißt, wie aus einem Touchpoint ein Funnel wird. Proaktivität: Statt auf ein Briefing zu warten, erkennst du früh, wo ein Channel Potenzial hat, welche Ziele es braucht und wann Sales ins Spiel kommt. Du trittst gegenüber Stakeholdern bis zum C-Level souverän auf und überzeugst mit Kommunikationsstärke und Begeisterung. Große und kleine (Networking-)Events sind genau dein Ding. Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu und bist mittendrin statt nur dabei. Reisebereitschaft von ca. 20–30 %. Unsere Branche ist klein und manchmal speziell, deshalb ist ein Gespür für die Zielgruppe wichtig. Gerade am Anfang solltest du oft vor Ort dabei sein. Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch. Englisch ist unsere Unternehmenssprache in einem diversen, internationalen Team. Führerschein Klasse B, damit du vor Ort flexibel unterwegs bist. Du lebst in Köln oder Umgebung und kommst gern regelmäßig ins Office, vor allem zum Marketing Monday. Homeoffice ist selbstverständlich, persönlicher Austausch ist uns trotzdem wichtig, und viele Events finden ohnehin in Köln statt. Du verstehst, worauf es für epilot ankommt, und richtest deine täglichen Entscheidungen danach aus. Als Teamplayer:in motivierst und begeisterst du deine Kolleg:innen und willst etwas bewegen. Du lebst TikTok nicht nur, sondern verstehst, warum ein Video funktioniert – Hook, Pacing, Sound, Trend-Timing. Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch – deine Community folgt dir gerne, und auch die Abstimmung mit dem Content & Communications Team läuft reibungslos. title: Software Engineering Director
description: <p><strong>THE POSITION<br></strong>Our roster has an opening with your name on it</p> <p>Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them.</p> <p>We are looking for a Software Engineering Director to lead the teams behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain.</p> <p>CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it.</p> <p>The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle <em>Everything Begins with the Customer.</em></p> <p>That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in minutes, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day.</p> <p>This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead managers and senior engineers across several teams, set technical direction alongside your Principal and Senior Staff Engineers, make the difficult calls that do not have obvious answers, and create the conditions in which good teams do the best work of their careers. You will work as closely with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations as you do with engineers, and you can explain a technical trade-off to an executive audience without diluting it.</p> <p>You are candid about what is not working and you know when to look for consensus and when the decision is yours, <em>Challenge and Commit.</em> You wear your FanDuel hat first and do not restrict yourself to organisational boundaries, <em>We are One Team.</em> You are a visible part of the domain leadership team and a role model to the wider engineering community, <em>Humble and Hungry.</em></p> <p><strong>THE GAME PLAN</strong><br>Everyone on our team has a part to play</p> <ul> <li>Lead multiple engineering teams within CPE, setting a clear technical vision for each area and holding delivery to it.</li> <li>Own the customer outcomes your teams are accountable for, measured where the fan feels them: registration and verification completion, time to first bet, deposit and withdrawal success rates, payout speed, geolocation pass rates, and the availability of whole journeys rather than the uptime of individual services.</li> <li>Set the standard for availability and operational excellence in a domain where an outage stops the rest of the product working, including the KPIs, the instrumentation behind them, and the discipline to tell genuine degradation from noise.</li> <li>Prepare for event-driven peak load so that the biggest days in the sporting calendar are rehearsed, with capacity, failover and degradation behaviour proven in advance.</li> <li>Reduce the blast radius of third-party failure across payment providers, identity and KYC vendors and geolocation suppliers, using redundancy, graceful degradation and clear fallbacks so that a supplier’s outage does not become a customer’s.</li> <li>Treat regulation as an engineering requirement, designing for auditability, evidence, data boundaries and jurisdictional variation from the start, and building the relationship with Compliance and Legal that lets us move quickly and safely.</li> <li>Hold responsible gaming and player integrity to the same product standard as any revenue-generating feature. Fans should be protected by systems that are accurate and timely, and that stay out of the way of people playing well within their means.</li> <li>Simplify the estate you inherit. Retire duplicated capability, reduce coupling between teams and improve lead time to change, so the domain is easier to work in each quarter than it was the last.</li> <li>Set the standard for how AI is used across the software lifecycle in your teams, including where we choose not to use it, with evidence of the effect on throughput, quality and security and the judgment to tell real uplift from theatre.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Customer Operations to shape the roadmap early, so that capabilities are designed in at inception.</li> <li>Make sure the right people are in the right jobs through hiring, development, performance management and creating leadership opportunities, and lead with empathy.</li> <li>Grow the managers and senior engineers who report to you, giving them the context and the scope to make decisions themselves rather than routing them through you.</li> <li>Make sure the domain is supported properly in production, including on-call and incident response, and that corrective actions are completed rather than logged.</li> <li>Deliver architecturally sound solutions to complex problems, making considered build-versus-buy decisions and designing for scale, reliability and a multi-year horizon.</li> <li>Communicate and progress strategic initiatives on a three to five year horizon covering platform evolution, money movement architecture and the shape of the domain.</li> <li>Be accountable for your budget, spend it carefully, and recognise waste in tooling, infrastructure, vendor services and payment processing costs.</li> <li>Exemplify our company principles and support a culture of quality, candour and collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>THE STATS</strong><br>What we're looking for in our next teammate</p> <p>We don’t expect you necessarily to have all of these to apply but they all count.</p> <ul> <li>10+ years in a software role, with 5+ years leading engineering teams. Experience leading other managers.</li> <li>A track record of delivering and running high-volume transactional systems where correctness, money and customer trust are all at stake, ideally in payments, financial services, identity or another regulated domain.</li> <li>Experience with highly available, fault-tolerant systems under extreme, event-driven peak load, from design through to production support.</li> <li>Experience building on third parties at scale, for example payment service providers, KYC and identity vendors or geolocation suppliers, including the operational and commercial realities of those relationships.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a regulated environment, where auditability, evidence and data boundaries shape the design.</li> <li>Experience with observability and with using data and KPIs to make engineering decisions and to hold a domain to a measurable standard of availability and performance.</li> <li>Deep experience in modern back-end languages, functional and object-oriented, including Java, and with cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containers and orchestration.</li> <li>Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted software development, with a considered view of where it belongs in the lifecycle, where it does not, and what a regulated environment allows it to touch.</li> <li>Experience defining and implementing software delivery practices and agile methods, with evidence of improving delivery pace while maintaining quality.</li> <li>Experience supporting software systems in production, including on-call, with a sustained focus on improving their stability, availability and performance.</li> <li>Experience delivering technology solutions with partner development teams through near-shore, off-shore or third-party arrangements.</li> <li>Experience designing and delivering technology for consumer-facing products in a fast-moving, ambiguous and closely scrutinised environment.</li> <li>Experience defining and executing a strategic technical vision, and the communication skills to carry it with engineers and executives alike.</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>THE CONTRACT</strong><br>We treat our team right</p> <p>Competitive compensation is just the beginning. As part of our team, you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>An exciting and fun environment committed to driving real growth</li> <li>Opportunities to build really cool products that fans love</li> <li>Mentorship and professional development resources to help you refine your game</li> <li>Flexible vacation allowance to let you refuel</li> <li>Hall of Fame benefit programs and platforms</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>ABOUT FANDUEL</strong></p> <p>FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. &nbsp;</p> <p>In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.</p> <p>The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.</p> <p>FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
