title: Dedicated Support Engineer - London
description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support. We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution. Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements. In this role, you will: Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents. Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation. Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers. Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through. Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners. Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams. Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes. Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates. Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations. Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed. Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure. Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments. Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation. Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally. You might thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues. Have expert-level troubleshooting skills and a strong track record of resolving ambiguous technical problems across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations. Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses. Have experience leading or playing a central role in customer-impacting incidents, including severity assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through. Can write code or scripts to reproduce issues, interrogate systems, automate repetitive work, and improve internal tools. Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages is valuable. Can communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders—especially when information is incomplete or evolving. Build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining clear and scalable ownership boundaries. Look beyond the immediate issue to identify patterns, improve the system, and prevent the same problem from recurring. Thrive in ambiguity, update quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to learn whatever is needed to get the job done. Bring a humble, team-first mindset, strong judgment, and a genuine eagerness to help both customers and colleagues succeed. Are excited to use OpenAI’s products, agents, and emerging AI capabilities to transform how technical support operates at scale. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . title: (Senior) Brand Designer
description: <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you'd never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>(Senior) Brand Designer</strong></p> <p>Moonfare is at an inflection point. We are 10 years in the making, with almost €4 billion in AUM and a new CMO recently in place, and the brand now carries more weight than it ever has. We are looking for a designer to make every surface we put in front of an investor look as though it was made on purpose.</p> <p>The person you are designing for is a partner at Freshfields, a Goldman MD, the principal of a small family office. They read curated material every day and they notice slippage immediately. Our reference points are Loro Piana, Aman, Cartier and Hauser &amp; Wirth — houses that wear their authority quietly and let the object carry the brand. We are a gallery rather than a supermarket, and the craft has to hold at that standard across a fund brochure, a thirty-two word invitation, a billboard at WEF and a single slide in a sales deck.</p> <p>The Brand Designer joins Moonfare's Marketing team — a high-output team responsible for building the brand, setting standards of excellence, generating demand, and driving investor acquisition across global markets. You will work daily with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance, and you will own the craft rather than coordinate it. This role reports to the CMO.&nbsp;</p> <p>AI tooling is business as usual in this team — Claude and Figma in the daily stack. The gain we want is not speed for its own sake. It is your hours moving from the mechanical end of production to the thinking.</p> <p><strong>You Will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the craft on every investor-facing surface — fund brochures, the annual letter, invitations, event environments, sales decks, web pages, paid assets — and hold the line on quality when the deadline argues otherwise.</li> <li>Tighten and maintain the design system: type, grid, colour, photography, motion and templates that let non-designers produce work which still looks like us.</li> <li>Design the fund marketing design system alongside Fund Marketing, so that each launch is assembled rather than reinvented, and the material reads like an LP memo rather than a brochure.</li> <li>Take long-form and content design seriously — due diligence summaries, research, the annual letter — where the job is clarity and restraint rather than decoration.</li> <li>Design for physical objects and rooms as fluently as for screens: printed matter, direct mail, gifts, signage and event environments, GTM launches and private dinners.</li> <li>Work inside compliance rather than around it, treating risk warnings and disclosures as a design problem to be solved properly.</li> <li>Bring an AI-first mindset to the production stack — concepting, variation, retouching, resizing and versioning — so that more of your time goes to the thinking and less to the mechanical.</li> <li>Art-direct external partners including photographers, illustrators, agencies and printers, and brief them well enough that the output needs little rescuing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Next Moonfarian:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You bring six or more years of design experience, with a portfolio that shows editorial and brand craft rather than campaign volume.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have designed for a luxury house, a gallery or museum, a serious publication or a premium consumer brand — or you can show that you understand that register and want to work in it.</li> <li>You bring an AI-native mindset — you use AI tools in your day-to-day and you have views on where they sharpen the work and where they flatten it.</li> <li>You are equally fluent in print and digital, and you have shipped physical work: something printed, bound, packaged or installed.</li> <li>You bring hands-on command of Figma and the Adobe suite</li> <li>You give feedback as well as take it, and you can explain a design decision to a non-designer without defensiveness or jargon.</li> <li>You can work at pace inside a regulated industry and you see compliance as a design constraint rather than a blocker.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is unlikely to be a good match if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Need a fully written brief before you can start. A good deal of this work begins as a conversation and a deadline.</li> <li>Prefer to direct rather than make. This is a hands-on role and the person in it designs every day.</li> <li>Are happiest producing high volumes of performance creative. Our channel mix is deliberately narrow, and quality of execution matters more here than volume of message.</li> <li>Find restraint frustrating rather than freeing. Our brand is built on hairline rules, whitespace and type weight rather than colour and ornament.</li> <li>Prefer to work at arm's length from the business. You will sit with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance constantly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Invest in Yourself:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership and Impact: </strong>You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Environment: </strong>We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.</li> <li><strong>Personal Growth: </strong>We support your development with an individual growth budget of £1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Invest in Your Future: </strong>We support your long-term financial goals with a workplace pension via SmartPension, where Moonfare contributes 3% and combined employer and employee contributions reach at least 8%.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Relax and Recharge: </strong>You start with 25 vacation days and you'll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days. Moonfare gifts two days during our annual end of year company shutdown.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Daily Lunch: </strong>Enjoy a £12 daily lunch allowance via Deliveroo on the days you're in the London office, delivered or ready to pick up nearby.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Fitness and Wellbeing: </strong>Stay active with a subsidised FitnessFirst membership, with £30 covered by Moonfare each month and no joining fee, plus a monthly guest pass and company wellness events.</li> <li><strong>Health Cover:</strong> Look after your health with private medical and dental cover through Bupa, including Select Complete Healthcare across 600 partner facilities and Dental Plan Level 2, with dependants covered up to age 24.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Cycle to Work:</strong> Ride in tax-efficiently through our salary-sacrifice scheme via Forest, available for an eBike or eMoped.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>A Culture of Excellence:</strong> Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Performance Reward: </strong>As a performance-first company, we reward strong performance twice a year, so your impact translates directly into how your pay grows — through potential base salary increases and/or bonuses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third — Client-Centric Focus. </strong>Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.</li> <li><strong>We pursue excellence and honor our promises — Commitment to Excellence. </strong>We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.</li> <li><strong>We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements — Win together. </strong>We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.</li> <li><strong>We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit — Growth and Merit. </strong>We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.</p> <h2>You're excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system</li> <li>You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market</li> <li>You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai</li> <li>You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation</li> <li>You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives</li> <li>You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators</li> <li>You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt</li> </ul> <div> <h2>Why Join Us?</h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Analyst Roles</span></span></h3> <p>Our Analyst roles give you the opportunity to build a career in an award-winning management consultancy firm while contributing to meaningful client work from day one. You will develop an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery.</p> <p>As an Analyst you will join a real consulting team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside structured development to help you learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">About the Government team at Baringa</span></span></h3> <p>Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.</p> <p>We work on Government’s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.</p> <p>The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated Analysts who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience – we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>We will embed you in client projects as part of a consulting team, working alongside experienced consultants to learn while delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.</p> <p>Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:</p> <ul> <li>Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.</li> <li>Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.</li> <li>Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.</li> <li>Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.</li> <li>Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:</p> <ul> <li>Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.</li> <li>Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.</li> <li>Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.</li> <li>Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.</li> <li>Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.</li> <li>Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What are we looking for?</span></span></h3> <p>We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.</p> <p>We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Structured problem solving</strong>, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.</li> <li><strong>Data analysis skills</strong>, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Digital and AI literacy</strong>, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.</li> <li><strong>Interest in policy, government and public service</strong>, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.</li> <li><strong>Commercial and financial curiosity</strong>, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication skills</strong>, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative approach</strong>, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to learn and adapt</strong>, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.</li> <li><strong>Attention to detail and ownership</strong>, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.</li> <li><strong>A proactive attitude</strong>, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.</li> </ul> <p>We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <p>An Analyst role at Baringa is what you make it.</p> <p>This is a permanent role where you will gain real project experience alongside structured coaching, training and development. You will build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills while learning how to support clients, work within high-performing teams and grow as a consultant.</p> <p>You will be part of a collaborative, supportive environment where you can learn from experienced consultants, explore different types of public sector work, and build a long-term career with Baringa.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Requirements</span></span></h3> <p>Applicants should have a strong academic record or equivalent experience, with an interest in consulting and public sector work. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</p> <p>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Key dates</span></span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Application window closes: </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Monday 19</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun Superscript SCXW214530584 BCX8" data-fontsize="11">th</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8"> October, 12pm GMT Midday</span></span><span class="LineBreakBlob BlobObject DragDrop SCXW214530584 BCX8"><span class="SCXW214530584 BCX8">&nbsp;</span><br class="SCXW214530584 BCX8"></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Assessment centres: </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">New Year 2027</span></span><span class="LineBreakBlob BlobObject DragDrop SCXW214530584 BCX8"><span class="SCXW214530584 BCX8">&nbsp;</span><br class="SCXW214530584 BCX8"></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa</span> May &amp; <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">September 2027</span></span></span></span></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Generous Annual Leave Policy:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="2" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Flexible Working:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="3" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Corporate Responsibility Days:</span><span data-contrast="none"> Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="4" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Wellbeing Fund:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">An award-winning workplace</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. </span><a href="https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/"><span data-contrast="none">Click here</span></a><span data-contrast="none"> to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Using business as a force for good.</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">Join us</span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-teams="true">All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Products &amp; Services</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p>The business units currently hiring are:</p> <p><strong>Technology, Media &amp; Telecoms</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Adam to confirm</u></strong></p> <p><strong>Consumer Products &amp; Retail</strong></p> <p>Customer expectations are in flux. Commerce straddles the physical and digital worlds. Inflation is fuelling economic uncertainty. Supply chains are stretched. And sustainability is in the spotlight. In these exceptional times, we use our deep industry knowledge and pragmatic transformation experience to help consumer products and retail companies transform to remain relevant today and thrive into tomorrow. </p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis and modelling, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management</em></p> <p><strong>Industrial Manufacturing</strong></p> <p>We partner with our Manufacturing clients to shape the future - securely, sustainably, and at scale. Our team bring expertise in industrial performance, operational resilience, and the transformation of complex manufacturing ecosystems. We work with leading manufacturers across automotive, aerospace &amp; defence, industrial engineering and advanced manufacturing, helping them improve performance, build resilience and deliver sustainable growth through practical, hands-on transformation.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Proactive curiosity, Interest in Manufacturing.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: </em><em>Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering</em></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">So, what's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&nbsp;</li> <li>You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can talk to anyone in the business. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: #00358e; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our Graduate Analyst Programme</span></h3> <p>Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Energy &amp; Resources</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p><strong>The business units currently hiring are:</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Commodities Energy &amp; Trading</u></strong><br><br>Our commodities and energy trading focused team operates across all major commodity and energy companies in Europe, the US and Singapore. From metals traders and miners, through oil majors, freight and shipping specialists to power and gas traders. Our people bring deep industry expertise to help our clients translate strategy into action, to enter new markets, build new trading capabilities, and to revolutionize their IT landscapes. <br><br>"From day one I have worked directly with clients on their complex trading transformation journeys. This has involved face-to-face engagement with our internationally based clients, visiting client site within weeks of starting at Baringa."</p> <p><em>Desired skills: Problem solving, IT interest, data skills, interest in commodity markets, personable and confident on client site</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: </em><em>Engineering, Economics, Data science</em></p> <p><strong><u>Energy Products</u></strong></p> <p>We turn Baringa's deep energy market expertise into trusted data, insights and software products that our clients rely on as they navigate the energy transition. Our team create the market simulations and forecasts used by investors, developers, and utilities around the world to support strategic decision-making. We combine experts covering energy markets, data science, software development, and economics to create digestible data-led insight to our clients. Depending on your background you could be working with either our market research, modelling, or communications teams</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: </em><em>A keen interest in energy markets, comfortable handling large datasets and extracting insight for a wide audience, clear presentation and storytelling ability, programming (e.g. Python, SQL), using AI (for coding, for agentic workflows), experience using numerical models/simulation, interpersonal skills.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: STEM subjects, Economics, Operational Research</em></p> <p><strong><u>Markets &amp; Transactions</u></strong></p> <p>We help investors, developers, utilities, lenders and corporates make well-informed commercial decisions across the energy transition. We combine deep expertise in energy markets and infrastructure with strong commercial and transaction advisory capabilities.</p> <p>Our work ranges from market fundamentals analysis, power price forecasting and asset optimisation through to commercial strategy, M&amp;A transactions, financing processes and investment due diligence. We work on some of the energy sector's most complex and high-profile challenges, helping clients deploy capital, manage risk and unlock value in rapidly evolving markets.</p> <p>Successful candidates will combine analytical rigour and curiosity with a strong commercial mindset, and an interest in understanding how energy markets, investment decisions and business strategy intersect.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Commercial acumen and strategic thinking, Quantitative analysis, modelling and data interpretation, Structured problem-solving and critical thinking, Energy market and energy systems knowledge, financial analysis and investment appraisal, Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, Ability to synthesise complex information into clear recommendations</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, Business / Management, Data Science, Statistics or Operational Research, Other quantitative disciplines.</em></p> <p><strong><u>Economics, Policy, Regulation, and Commercial</u></strong></p> <p>We support clients from policy development to implementation, from regulatory strategies to business case submissions, and from competition cases to expert opinion. Our economists, policy specialists, regulatory experts and techno-economic modellers work alongside governments, regulators, investors and corporates - shaping the frameworks and decisions that underpin multi-billion-pound investment across energy, utilities and wider infrastructure.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Economic and quantitative analysis, written communication, structured problem-solving, policy &amp; regulatory awareness, interpersonal skills.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Economics, Public Policy, Politics/PPE, Econometrics, Statistics, Finance</em></p> <p><strong><u>Transition, Assets and Infrastructure</u></strong></p> <p>Our Transition, Assets &amp; Infrastructure team helps energy, utilities and infrastructure organisations deliver complex transformation across the full asset asset lifecycle&nbsp; from&nbsp; capital programmes, asset management, operate and maintain and decommissioning.&nbsp; We work with clients to develop their asset strategy, improve the performance of critical infrastructure, deliver large-scale capital investments, shape future operating models, and unlock value through technology, data and AI. Combining expertise in engineering, project delivery, operations, technology and business transformation, we help clients solve complex challenges and deliver lasting outcomes across asset-intensive industries.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Problem Solving, Curiosity &amp; Learning Mindset, Strong Communication Skills, Analytical &amp; Structured Thinking, Interest in Energy, Infrastructure and Technology</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: STEM including engineering disciplines, Data Science,&nbsp; etc.</em></p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">So, what's in it for you?</span></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&nbsp;</li> <li>You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&nbsp;</li> <li>We’re proud to put people first with wellbeing at the forefront of our culture, one example of this is that every employee receives £300 a year to put towards their wellbeing!</li> <li>All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme, which seeks to ensure that everyone has a stake in the success of the company.&nbsp;</li> <li>We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break - As such we have introduced the ‘Re-charge’ benefit meaning Baringa will offer all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lastly, we recognise the importance of work-life balance and we know that the ‘ideal’ balance will vary from person to person and will change at different stages of our working lives.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Requirements:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Applicants must have&nbsp;the&nbsp;permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future.</li> <li>All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><u>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</u>&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Key Dates:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Application window closes:</li> <li>Assessment centres:</li> </ul> <p>We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa May 2027/September 2027</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h2> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. Some of these benefits include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Generous Annual Leave Policy:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Capabilities
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Graduate Analyst Programme</span></span></h3> <p>Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Capabilities</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p><strong>The business units currently hiring are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Customer</strong></p> <p>Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX &amp; UI, and Marketing</em></p> <p><strong>Enterprise Value Creation</strong></p> <p>Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mindset, and practical delivery expertise. We advise executive leadership teams to identify opportunities, solve complex business problems and deliver sustainable improvements in growth, profitability, and performance.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Open to all degree types.</em></p> <p><strong>Organisation, People &amp; Change </strong></p> <p>Organisation, People, and Change (OPC) enables organisations to achieve lasting success by putting people at the centre of transformation. With a holistic approach, our team helps clients align their operating models, people strategies, structures, and cultures with their strategic ambitions. OPC ensures organisations are equipped to deliver impact that lasts through an engaged and high-performing workforce.</p> <p>As part of OPC, you will have the opportunity to work across a range of sectors, helping clients with a range of solutions:</p> <ul> <li>Optimising operations and organisational design: Align business capabilities, processes, and technology with the strategic ambition to drive efficiency and effectiveness.</li> <li>Unlocking leadership, culture, and workforce potential: Shape future skills, foster an engaged and high-performing workforce, and embed target cultures through people-led experiences.</li> <li>Crafting and delivering transformation and change strategies: Define the vision, strategic direction, and OKRs to create positive conditions for change, enabling organisations to deliver lasting impact.</li> </ul> <p><em>Desired Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, Organisation and project management capability, Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, AI literacy and an interest in innovation, A genuine passion for consulting and transforming organisations and workforces through meaningful change.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees (not essential): Business management / Management and Organisational Behaviour, Psychology / Organisational Psychology, Engineering - critical thinking / problem solving, Data Analytics / Business Analytics.</em></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain &amp; Procurement </strong></p> <p>The SCP team helps organisations tackle complex challenges across their supply chains, procurement functions and commercial operations. Working with clients across the public and private sectors, we help organisations navigate an increasingly uncertain world, responding to challenges such as cost pressures, supply chain disruption, changing customer expectations and rapid technological change.</p> <p>As part of SCP, you'll work on a diverse range of projects spanning supply chain strategy, procurement transformation, commercial advisory, logistics, and technology-enabled change, as part of either our Supply Chain or Procurement &amp; Commercial practice. Our teams combine analytical thinking, practical problem-solving and deep industry expertise to help clients create efficient, resilient and sustainable organisations that deliver lasting value.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Team collaboration and effective communication, Adaptability and personal resilience, Proactive curiosity, Digital literacy.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: No degree preference, analytical capabilities are key. If you have commercial acumen this is a bonus. Candidates may benefit from STEM experience, but this is not a requirement.</em></p> <p><strong>Data, AI, Solutions &amp; Engineering</strong></p> <p>Expertly applied, data and AI empower you to operate smarter, innovate faster and compete harder. Blending exceptional technical skills with deep industry knowledge, our consultants make the possibilities real. We are experts in crafting practical data and AI solutions and integrating these into existing production workflows. Where data and AI requires new scalable technology, we work with you to establish the case for investment. And when new data insights are revealed, we ensure you have the right talent to unlock full value. Whether you are looking to establish a robust data infrastructure, foster a data-driven culture or ensure data and information security and compliance are maintained, we can help.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Problem Solving, Data Analysis, Data Literacy, Technical Data Skills - BI, Python, Engineering, ML, Other coding languages.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: STEM, Computer Science, Data Science, Other technical data/AI degrees</em></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">So, what's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&nbsp;</li> <li>You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&nbsp;</li> <li>We’re proud to put people first with wellbeing at the forefront of our culture, one example of this is that every employee receives £300 a year to put towards their wellbeing!</li> <li>All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme, which seeks to ensure that everyone has a stake in the success of the company.&nbsp;</li> <li>We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break - As such we have introduced the ‘Re-charge’ benefit meaning Baringa will offer all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lastly, we recognise the importance of work-life balance and we know that the ‘ideal’ balance will vary from person to person and will change at different stages of our working lives.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Requirements</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Applicants must have&nbsp;the&nbsp;permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future.</li> <li>All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}"><u>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</u>&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Key dates</span></span></h3> <p>Application window closes: Monday 19<sup>th</sup> October, 12pm GMT Midday<br>Assessment centres: New Year 2027<br>We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa September 2027</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h2> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Generous Annual Leave Policy:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="2" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Flexible Working:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="3" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Corporate Responsibility Days:</span><span data-contrast="none"> Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="4" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Wellbeing Fund:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="5" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Profit Share Scheme:</span><span data-contrast="none"> All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">Diversity and Inclusion</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);" data-contrast="none">An award-winning workplace</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. </span><a href="https://www.baringa.com/en/impact/awards/"><span data-contrast="none">Click here</span></a><span data-contrast="none"> to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.</span>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Using business as a force for good.</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. title: Senior Photonics Engineer, Optical Interfaces
description: <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum’s&nbsp;mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our architecture and approach&nbsp;is&nbsp;based on silicon photonics. By&nbsp;leveraging&nbsp;the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons&nbsp;don’t&nbsp;feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In 2024,&nbsp;PsiQuantum&nbsp;announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">PsiQuantum&nbsp;also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It&nbsp;represents&nbsp;a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be&nbsp;solved&nbsp;any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear&nbsp;path&nbsp;to make it real.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Come join us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Photonics Engineer to develop ultra-low-loss optical interface solutions between dissimilar, exploratory, waveguiding platforms. This role combines device concept development, optical simulation, and hands-on experimental validation to assess and mature new approaches for mode conversion and coupling. The successful candidate will combine creativity in photonic device design with strong engineering judgement, identifying solutions that are both high-performing and practical to deploy. Working closely with internal teams and expert external partners, they will help guide the development of advanced optical interfaces. We welcome applicants from both advanced industrial photonics environments and leading research groups who combine strong physical intuition with practical experimental and engineering judgement.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <div class="ak-renderer-extension " data-layout="default" data-local-id="b6839916-5a17-444d-935b-16560225fcb8"> <div class="ak-renderer-extension-inner-wrapper ak-renderer-extension-overflow-container css-1xdhyk6"> <div class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _ca0q1b66" data-testid="field-container"> <div class="_1e0c1txw _vchhusvi _2lx21bp4 _1bah1fhb"> <div class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw" data-testid="field-input-paragraph-rich-text-view-3"> <div class="ak-renderer-wrapper is-undefined css-pw7jst"> <div class="css-1hzk891"> <div class="ak-renderer-document"> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="3">Develop and assess novel device concepts for ultra-low-loss optical coupling and mode
