If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

his is a pure new-logo role. You will win the large, multi-country property owners, operators and facilities management organisations that do not yet work with Singu, running the full cycle from first cold conversation to signature. Once an account is live, Customer Success takes it forward.

Why Singu

Singu is building a leading international property operations platform. We support more than 250 million square metres of property, retain over 98% of our customers, profitable and growing at double digits year on year with backing from K1 Investment Management.

Our customers already include seven of Europe’s ten largest logistics platforms, the five leading global commercial real estate advisers and 17 of Europe’s top 20 facilities management providers.

What To Expect

  • A defined greenfield territory of named target accounts

  • Reference customers with genuine weight in the market and proof points that survive scrutiny.

  • Direct access to the CRO and CEO, who will show up on your deals when it matters, with Presales, Business Development, Marketing and Product behind you.

  • Uncapped commission with accelerators - overperformance is rewarded.

  • A credible path into enterprise sales leadership as the new-business function scales.

What You Will Own

Pipeline Creation

  • Build and work a named target-account list across your territory, with a written point of view on why each account should change and what it would take.

  • Generate the majority of your own pipeline, at coverage that supports next year’s number rather than this quarter’s. Business development and marketing will contribute; they will not carry you.

  • Multi-thread into C-suite and operational leadership through outbound, industry networks, events, partners and existing customer relationships.

Winning Complex Enterprise Deals

  • Run the full cycle: first conversation, discovery, business case, evaluation, negotiation and signature.

  • Displace incumbent CAFM and IWMS platforms, in-house systems and entrenched spreadsheet processes.

  • Navigate multi-country buying groups, procurement, IT security and legal without losing momentum.

  • Qualify hard using MEDDICC and with mutual action plans on every live deal.

  • Shape commercial structure: pricing, multi-year terms, phased rollouts and land-and-expand entry points that create a platform for growth.

  • Sell what we can deliver and hand over cleanly.

Executive Credibility

  • Earn access to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Heads of Real Estate and workplace and transformation sponsors, and hold the room once you are in it.

  • Lead with the commercial case: operating cost, compliance exposure, portfolio performance and risk, rather than a feature demonstration.

  • Mobilise Presales, Product and executive sponsorship around the opportunities that justify it.

Forecast and Commercial Discipline

  • Maintain a forecast you can defend line by line, and a CRM that reflects reality rather than optimism.

  • Disqualify early and visibly. Time returned to a real deal is worth more than a full-looking pipeline.

  • Feed competitive and market intelligence back into product, marketing and pricing.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • New-logo ARR closed against target, and the calibre of the logos, how many become referenceable

  • Self-sourced pipeline as a share of total pipeline

  • Win rate and average deal size within the named target segment

  • Forecast accuracy against commit

  • Deal quality: economic buyer access, mutual action plan, MEDDICC completeness

  • Speed and honesty of disqualification, and clean handover into onboarding

What We’re Looking For

  • A sustained record of exceeding new-business quota

  • Complex enterprise deals closed at six or seven-figure value across borders, involving multiple stakeholders, procurement and IT security review.

  • Demonstrable self-sourced pipeline: the accounts you opened cold, how you got in, and what you actually said.

  • Commercial credibility at C-level, with the ability to build and defend a business case in front of a finance audience.

  • Comfort operating where the playbook is still being written, and the discipline to write down what works.

  • MEDDICC, or an equivalent qualification and messaging framework used in practice

  • CAFM, IWMS, facilities management, PropTech or real estate technology experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Support, Package and Progression

  • Dedicated Solution Consulting, business development support, and marketing programmes aimed at your segment.

  • An established customer base and proof points that open doors, plus CEO and CRO sponsorship on request.

  • Competitive salary with uncapped commission and accelerators above target.

  • Genuine progression into enterprise sales leadership as the new-business team grows.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Introduction</span></strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for STEM graduates keen to start making real products for our clients.&nbsp; You’ll need to be eager to turn your hand to a lot of different tasks and enjoy constantly learning new things.&nbsp; In return we can offer the chance to tackle some of the hardest engineering problems around, such as <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/a-step-change-in-ai-based-robotics-for-military-logistics/">novel applications of robotics</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.wired.com/video/watch/an-inside-look-at-legos-new-tech-packed-smart-brick">collaborating with LEGO</a> to develop <a href="https://www.wired.com/story/exclusive-inside-look-at-new-lego-smart-brick/">LEGO® SMART Play™</a> &nbsp;and <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/overcoming-smart-meter-challenges-for-the-last-5/">other embedded products</a>, as well as defence and national security projects such as <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/pioneering-ai-cyberattack-response-for-the-uk-military/">pioneering AI cyberattack response for the UK military</a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Overview </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:160,&quot;335559739&quot;:80}">&nbsp;</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Cambridge Consultants undertakes over 300 technology, design and consulting projects every year. You will get to work across the broad range of markets, from Consumer Devices to Industrial Systems to Defence and National Security. The Electronics and Software group is a cohesive team of multi-disciplinary experts in everything to do with embedded systems and devices – whether that’s electronics, embedded software, physics, control, communications, security or algorithm design.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now, and we mentor our team to grow them into brilliant technologists. We need people who are enthusiastic about learning, keen to pick up new skills, and can show evidence of a rigorous approach to solving real-world problems. An ability to learn and a determination to grow are more important than the knowledge you already have.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Your responsibilities</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:160,&quot;335559739&quot;:80}">&nbsp;</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">With lots of support and guidance from your peers, you will work as part of our technical team on client assignments in multi-disciplinary projects for a wide range of markets. You may work on one or more projects at a time, in a variety of different disciplines and roles.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will work on the design and implementation of systems for a wide range of applications and products. You will have many opportunities to develop your technical design skills for analogue and digital hardware, information engineering, embedded software, control, communications and whole product design. This could include writing software in C for embedded targets, writing SystemVerilog for FPGAs, PCB design and hardware testing.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will have the chance to interact directly with clients at all phases of projects, from requirements capture and progress updates to final handover.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About you</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re looking for applicants with the following experience or skills:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">An excellent degree or PhD in general, electrical, electronic or information engineering, computer science or physics.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Experience through university, work or home projects in at least one of the following areas, and enthusiasm for learning about the others:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">PCB design</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Digital electronics (processors, memory, DSP, Verilog, VHDL)</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Analogue electronics (general, interfaces, RF, power)</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-contrast="auto">Software implementation in C, C++, Rust, or a similar programming language</span>&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We welcome applications from recent graduates with industrial experience, final year students and graduates with relevant academic course or research experience. We are looking for excellence and are as interested in your skills and ability to learn quickly as we are in your experience.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any software, electronics or engineering projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"><span data-contrast="auto">Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions.&nbsp;</span>This role requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance ( <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant">https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant</a> ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You may be designing filters for simulation of a system one week, getting hands on with programming for a platform the next, or providing vectors or interpreting results from our hardware test team.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>We take pride in being ahead of the technology curve, working with and developing exciting new technology. title: Realtime Analytics and Controls Developer
description: <p><strong>The Firm</strong></p> <p>XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 50,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 250 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 650 petabytes of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the next generation of Affirm’s Comms Plat. The opportunity spans two connected areas: (1) Modernizing the platform that powers critical transactional communications across channels; (2) Building shared capabilities that help Affirm create a more coordinated experience across marketing and transactional comms. Together, this work will simplify how teams build and manage communications, strengthen the reliability and scalability of our systems, and help us deliver more relevant and consistent customer experiences.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and teams across Product, Marketing, Ops, Design, Analytics, and Legal and Compliance to set product direction and turn it into capabilities teams can successfully adopt. You’ll navigate complex technical and business tradeoffs, balance near-term needs with longer-term platform investments, and help determine where Affirm should build capabilities directly versus work with third-party partners.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>Set product strategy and roadmap for Comms Plat, connecting customer needs, business priorities, and technical opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help modernize Affirm’s comms infrastructure and build shared capabilities that support more consistent experiences across transactional and marketing comms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead complex platform initiatives from strategy through launch and adoption, working closely with Engineering and cross-functional partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build strong relationships across Affirm so communications needs for new products, markets, and customer journeys are understood early and reflected in platform plans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape channel, platform, and partner strategy, including thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions across the communications ecosystem.</p> </li> <li> <p>Make clear tradeoffs across customer experience, reliability, scalability, cost, regulatory requirements, and speed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define meaningful measures of success and use customer, product, operational, and business signals to guide priorities and investment.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience, with a track record of leading complex products or platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building platform or other technically complex products. Comms or messaging experience is helpful, but not required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into a clear strategy and actionable roadmap.</p> </li> <li> <p>Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with Engineering on architecture, reliability, scalability, and platform tradeoffs.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of taking products beyond launch and driving adoption across multiple teams or customer groups.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong cross-functional influence and the ability to build alignment across teams with different priorities and constraints.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong analytical and business judgment, including the ability to weigh customer impact, operating complexity, cost, and risk when making decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics understandable and bring stakeholders along in the decision-making process.</p> </li> <li> <p>A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay focused on the experience the platform ultimately creates, even when working deep in infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfort operating with ambiguity, using judgment and available information to move work forward while adapting as you learn.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Base Pay Grade: P</p> <p>Equity Grade: UK 7</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.</p> <p>GBR base pay range per year<strong>: £<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_0" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">142,000</span>&nbsp;-&nbsp;<span data-formula-id="_c_f_4zYZFddFQ5_1" data-error="false" data-placeholder="false" data-loading="false" data-recalculating="false" data-inactive="false">190,000</span></strong></p> <p>Location: Remote UK</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p>In this role you will be responsible for one of THG Fulfil's largest and most complex accounts, spanning B2B/channel and B2C/D2C fulfilment, inbound and new product introduction (NPI), value-added services, systems integration, and commercial administration, with direct exposure to both client leadership and THG group executives.</p> <h1><strong>The Role</strong></h1> <p>This is one of the most strategic, highest-visibility accounts in the Fulfil portfolio, and a newly created, dedicated role to match. It carries real intensity: a daily governance and reporting obligation, and a breadth of scope across B2B, B2C/D2C, inbound, NPI, VAS, integrations and commercial that effectively spans several workstreams under one relationship.</p> <p>With that comes genuine ownership. The successful candidate will be THG's primary point of contact for the client's operational, logistics and programme teams, translating their requirements into internal action across warehouse operations, transport, IT/integrations, ISC and commercial — and holding those teams to delivery. They will own the account's governance calendar and daily reporting, resolve escalations end-to-end, and hold credible technical conversations on integrations without needing to do that work personally. This is a role for someone who wants to run something significant, not administer it.</p> <h1><strong>Why This Role</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Real seniority from day one:</strong>&nbsp;of one of Fulfil's largest and most complex accounts — you're the person in the room with senior leadership on both sides, not a supporting player.</li> <li><strong>A genuine growth track:</strong>&nbsp;this account and role are being created because the business is investing in getting its biggest relationships right; strong performance here is a natural springboard toward Account Director.</li> <li><strong>Influence, not just delivery:</strong>&nbsp;you'll shape governance, commercial terms and how internal teams organise around the account, rather than just following a playbook.</li> <li><strong>Depth over breadth:</strong>&nbsp;rather than spread thin across a portfolio, this is a rare chance to build deep, specialist expertise across the commercial, operational and technical sides of one major account.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Client Relationship &amp; Day-to-Day Ownership</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Act as the primary THG point of contact</strong>&nbsp;for the client's operational, logistics and programme teams, including their EMEA fulfilment, transportation, global service &amp; logistics and extended workforce (xWF) partners.</li> <li><strong>Run a weekly 1:1 with the client account lead,</strong>&nbsp;plus regular ad hoc syncs with programme and technical contacts, translating requirements into internal actions across warehouse operations, transport, IT/integrations, ISC and commercial — and holding those teams to delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Governance &amp; Reporting</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own the account's governance calendar,</strong>&nbsp;including MBRs, QBRs, daily hypercare calls, and weekly ops, VAS, D2C &amp; Inbound and PM check-in calls — a minimum of two hours of scheduled client contact every working day before reporting, escalation handling or project work.</li> <li><strong>Produce supporting evidence packs</strong>&nbsp;for dispute resolution, and supply data extracts on request.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Escalation &amp; Incident Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own live, cross-functional escalations end-to-end,</strong>&nbsp;keeping internal teams coordinated and the client informed throughout.</li> <li><strong>Provide same-day resolution and communication</strong>&nbsp;to the client and THG executives, including outside standard hours when escalations land on weekends.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Systems &amp; Integration Oversight</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Maintain working fluency in EDI and integration concepts</strong>&nbsp;sufficient to triage issues and hold credible technical conversations with the client's technical teams, without doing the integration work personally.</li> <li><strong>Support ongoing platform and project work</strong>&nbsp;including THG portal development, Fulfil UI change requests, and client-specific ISC process fixes, demos and training.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Project &amp; Change Delivery</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead delivery of account-specific projects and programmes</strong>&nbsp;(e.g. VAS/device rework programmes, NPI set-up, dangerous-goods order flow, EMEA programme initiatives) working across warehouse, transport, IT and ISC.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Commercial Support</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead commercial alignment sessions</strong>&nbsp;on activity outside the standard rate card (e.g. non-SSCC handling, decant, space over-allocation, DG printing), providing the operational evidence base for commercial and compliance discussions.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Requirements</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Client-facing account management experience</strong>&nbsp;in third-party logistics or supply chain, ideally with enterprise technology or consumer electronics clients.</li> <li><strong>Strong data and reporting capability</strong>&nbsp;— able to build compliance and performance reporting from raw operational data without analyst support.</li> <li><strong>Working understanding of EDI and integration concepts</strong>&nbsp;(945s, SSCC, IMEI and serialised stock, ASN flows) sufficient to triage issues and hold a credible technical conversation.</li> <li><strong>Confident operating at executive level</strong>&nbsp;on both sides of the relationship, including under escalation.</li> <li><strong>Able to influence internal operational teams without direct line authority</strong>&nbsp;across warehouse, transport, IT, ISC and commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>Resilience and availability —</strong>&nbsp;this account generates genuine out-of-hours and weekend demand during live escalations.</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to manage a high-volume governance calendar</strong>&nbsp;(ten or more recurring meetings per week) alongside reactive escalation and project work.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Client Executive
description: Who we are At Supermodular AI, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution. Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization. That's why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled. Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you'll feel at home at Supermodular AI. Your role As an AI Client Executive at supermodular.ai , you will own the development of strategic enterprise relationships and turn complex AI transformation opportunities into meaningful, long-term engagements. You will work directly with senior technology and business leaders to understand where AI can create material impact in their organizations. This means going beyond selling predefined services. You will need to understand how an organization operates, identify the problems worth solving, and work with our technical team to turn those problems into engagements we can execute. You will own the commercial relationship from the first conversation through closing and account expansion. You will create new opportunities, lead executive conversations, navigate complex buying organizations, and build the commercial case for working together. Many of the opportunities you pursue will not be clearly defined at the start. Customers may know they need to transform with AI without knowing where to begin, what to build, or how to operationalize it. Your role is to bring structure to that ambiguity, identify where we can create meaningful value, and build the relationships and momentum required to turn that opportunity into action. What you own Build your own pipeline through direct outreach, your network, referrals and strategic partnerships. Develop relationships with technology partners and turn them into joint opportunities and introductions. Open and develop relationships with senior technology and business leaders at target accounts. Lead discovery to understand priorities, uncover meaningful problems and qualify opportunities. Turn early conversations into clear opportunities with defined value, stakeholders and a path forward. Work with our technical team to shape the right engagement for the client. Own the commercial process from proposal through negotiation and close. Navigate stakeholders, procurement and other enterprise buying processes to maintain momentum. Grow initial engagements into larger, long-term client relationships. Own revenue across both new and existing clients. What you bring You have personally originated and closed complex enterprise deals. You have owned meaningful revenue targets and are comfortable being accountable for pipeline, closing and account growth. You know how to create new opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads or an established sales machine. You can build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders. You are strong at discovery and can turn an ambiguous business problem into a concrete opportunity. You are comfortable selling complex services where the solution is not always predefined. You understand technology well enough to lead credible customer conversations and know when to bring in deeper technical expertise. You can navigate complex enterprise buying processes with multiple stakeholders. You can build a strong business case, negotiate and move opportunities from interest to commitment. You have a track record of growing initial engagements into larger, long-term client relationships. For this role, approximately 35% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. description: <h4>Fresh Food, Happy Dogs.</h4> <p>We believe dogs deserve the healthiest, most natural and tastiest meals - with none of the nasties. As a B-Corp certified company, you’re joining a sustainable business that genuinely cares about our people, our products and our impact on the planet. Our goal is simple: to help dogs live healthier, happier, and longer lives, while leaving humans smiling after every interaction.</p> <p>We’ve come a long way since our co-founders (Kev &amp; Dave), hand delivered the very first Butternut Box. Today, we feed hundreds of thousands of hungry dogs across the UK and Europe - but we won’t stop until we’re feeding dogs everywhere. To get there, we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition to come and work for us.</p> <p>We’re looking for a hard-working, ambitious and highly analytical Senior FP&amp;A Analyst to join the team here at Butternut Box. The successful candidate would need to be a qualified accountant with FP&amp;A experience, strong Excel skills and be keen for a step up into a fast-paced environment where comfort with ambiguity is a must.</p> <p><strong>📣&nbsp;A bit about the role.</strong></p> <p>As a senior FP&amp;A analyst you will provide support to the business spanning all aspects of reporting, planning, forecasting and budgeting as well as insightful analysis to help the company meet its objectives. You will be comfortable both analysing bulk data and owning projects. In this role, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>Run the rolling forecast process. This will involve collating output from our management accounts and business leaders, to understand how deviations from plan impact the P&amp;L + cash over the short, medium and long term.</li> <li>Support budgeting and long range planning processes. Lead defined workstreams within our FP&amp;A cycle.</li> <li>Run periodic P&amp;L and cash variance analyses, identifying root causes and working with budget owners to implement solutions.</li> <li>Host 4-weekly periodic business reviews (PBRs) with budget owners. Understand the risks and opportunities facing the business to ensure we are having the right discussions and making timely decisions based on business performance.</li> <li>Work with our commercial teams to understand in granular detail: CPA, future growth rates, retention, channel effectiveness and where to allocate resources, customer profiles, etc.</li> <li>Work with our operational teams to understand in granular detail: unit economics, standard costs, yield, write-offs, OEE, etc.</li> <li>Model out scenarios for different product / market launches and growth initiatives. We are quickly expanding across Europe; this role will help us prepare for new market launches and will work closely with international teams to support their success.</li> <li>Present analysis to senior leadership and prepare quarterly board materials, including ad-hoc deep dives such as sensitivity analyses, margin drivers and working capital.</li> <li>Own processes and team goals. Use AI and automation to make our reporting faster and sharper.</li> </ul> <p><strong>👋&nbsp;A bit about you.</strong></p> <ul> <li>CIMA/ACCA/ACA qualified</li> <li>3+ years post-qualification, 2+ in FP&amp;A</li> <li>Proven self-starter with an entrepreneurial 'can do’ attitude</li> <li>Highly inquisitive and analytical&nbsp;mind capable of complex problem solving</li> <li>Passionate about how numbers can be transformed into key insight</li> <li>Advanced financial modelling skills</li> <li>Strong data manipulation and analysis skills</li> <li>Ability to produce clear graphical data representations&nbsp;&amp; present data in a clear way for finance and non-finance professionals</li> <li>Excellent communication skills</li> <li>Fine attention to detail with an eagle-eyed ability to spot trends and pick out inaccuracies</li> <li>A love for all things dogs!</li> </ul> <p>🍀 <strong>Nice to haves.</strong></p> <ul> <li>DTC experience, and a familiarity with cohorts, LTV and payback</li> <li>Manufacturing / standard costing experience</li> <li>Experience in reporting across multiple markets / jurisdictions</li> </ul> <p>⌨️ <strong>Tech stack.</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excel + g-sheets</li> <li>Datarails (FP&amp;A platform)</li> <li>SAP B1 (ERP)</li> <li>AI (Gemini, Claude, Gumloop)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌&nbsp;A bit about what we offer.</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary</li> <li>25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays) and an additional day for every year of service up to 5 years</li> <li>5 additional, paid 'paws' days off per year dedicated to your learning, development or personal wellbeing. Hit pause when you need it most</li> <li>£500 personal learning &amp; development budget to sharpen your skills</li> <li>Share options grant - everyone owns a piece of Butternut's success.</li> <li>A significant discount on our Fresh food, to keep your own dogs as healthy as our customers</li> <li>Enhanced parental leave</li> <li>Flexible core working hours</li> <li>Cycle to work scheme</li> <li>Pension with NEST</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance with Vitality</li> <li>Private Dental Insurance with Bupa</li> <li>Paid time off for fertility treatments and pregnancy loss</li> <li>Paid sabbaticals for squad members with 5 or more years service at Butternut</li> <li>Discounted gym access&nbsp;through&nbsp;MyGymDiscounts</li> <li>Lots of office dogs (Ajax, Peggy, Chief, Louis, Hansen, Winnie and many more….)</li> </ul> <h4>⏳ The interview process:</h4> <ol> <li>Initial call with your dedicated Talent Acquisition Partner, carried out remotely.</li> <li>Take home task, this will be sent to you via email.</li> <li>Skills interview, for 60 minutes, in person.</li> <li>Behaviours interview, for 60 minutes, followed by a 45 minute Leadership interview, in person.</li> </ol> <p><em>We usually expect our interview process to take 3-5 weeks, end to end.</em></p> <h4>💡 Important things to note:</h4> <ul> <li>Our team thrives on collaboration. We spend&nbsp;<strong>3 days a week in our West London office</strong> (Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday) and 2 days working from wherever you’re most productive. Because being together is a big part of our culture, we’re looking for someone within a comfortable commutable distance to London.</li> <li>We’re a small (but mighty!) recruitment team. We aim to respond to everyone personally, but if we’re flooded with brilliant applications, we may need to close the role early. We appreciate your patience while we review applications.</li> <li>For this specific role, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship, so you’ll need the right to work in the UK.</li> </ul> <h4>❗️We believe in a <strong>seat at the table for everyone.</strong></h4> <p>Butternut Box is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that to make the best food for <em>all</em> dogs, we need a team that represents <em>all</em> humans. We celebrate different nationalities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We are specifically committed to increasing representation from underrepresented groups. We want a strong, diverse team built from different identities and lived experiences. We’re not perfect, but we are dedicated to the ongoing work of building an inclusive, supportive place where you can do the best work of your career.</p> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><h4><strong>About this role</strong></h4> <p>Faire's quality, depth, and breadth of brands is its strongest value to retailers. Our Brand Partnerships team is at the forefront of Faire's success, ensuring that the best and most relevant brands join and thrive on our platform.</p> <p>This is not a role for someone looking to learn the ropes. This is a role for someone who has already mastered them. As a Senior Account Executive (L3), you will be a trusted advisor to Upmarket brands across Central &amp; Northern Europe, helping them unlock wholesale growth on Faire and driving incremental GMV at scale.</p> <p>This role is a blend of strategic thinking and high-velocity sales execution. You will own a complex, high-value portfolio of brands across your geos, proactively identifying and activating the best-fit brands for Faire. You bring a strong commercial mindset — comfortable from C-level to operational stakeholder — and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform.</p> <p>We are looking for a stellar performer: someone who has finished top 3 in their org, qualified for President's Club or All-Stars, and is hungry to do it again in a market that is genuinely early and genuinely exciting.</p> <h4>You're excited about this opportunity because...</h4> <ul> <li>You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in a market that isn't fully built yet — where your territory becomes the foundation others inherit</li> <li>You are energised by fast-moving, ambiguous environments and see AI as a genuine force multiplier, not a buzzword</li> <li>You want to sell something that actually matters — levelling the playing field for independent retailers against e-commerce and big-box giants is a mission you can get behind</li> <li>You want to work alongside a tight-knit team of high performers who share wins loudly, debug losses together, and hold themselves to a standard most sales teams only talk about</li> <li>You are curious by default — you dig until you understand, and you bring that intellectual rigour to every deal</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h4> <h4><strong>Identify and win the right opportunities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage a high-value book of business across Central &amp; Northern Europe with the goal of maximising the incremental GMV that new Upmarket brands bring to the Faire platform</li> <li>Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure</li> <li>Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both high volume and high quality</li> <li>Support new brands through their first quarter on Faire — ensuring they understand the platform and are set up to receive orders and grow</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Lead a best-in-class upmarket sales cycle</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead every customer interaction with a personalised, insight-led approach — understanding each brand's unique business and shaping Faire's value proposition to their specific problems</li> <li>Navigate multi-threaded deals with confidence: from C-suite vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales and marketing teams</li> <li>Develop tailored onboarding plans that balance near-term activation with long-term platform success</li> <li>Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on when to advance a deal and when to pass — and own the outcome either way</li> <li>Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Be the expert on your markets</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Be solution-oriented to common objections and geo-specific blockers — size the opportunity, identify what's needed, and act on it with product and leadership</li> <li>Understand how competitors and industry players operate and articulate Faire's key differentiators with precision</li> <li>Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across Central &amp; Northern Europe — and bring that intelligence back to sharpen team strategy</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Represent Faire across the wholesale industry</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Drive Faire's value props and messaging across the full sales surface: outreach, nurture, tradeshows, events, and in-person brand visits</li> <li>Identify and pursue new business opportunities that drive incremental revenue for the platform</li> <li>Develop content and host webinars to engage leads in your verticals and share onboarding best practices</li> <li>Collaborate with marketing to shape top-of-funnel messaging across paid, web, and nurture channels</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h4> <h4><strong>Must haves</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Proven track record of exceeding quota at upmarket level — top 3 in your org, President's Club / All-Stars qualifier</li> <li>High-velocity pipeline engine: ability to run multiple complex Upmarket deals simultaneously without sacrificing quality</li> <li>Sharp executive presence — comfortable operating from C-level to operational stakeholder</li> <li>AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to prospect, prep, and accelerate — not as a talking point but as a genuine lever</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity — you ask better questions, dig deeper, and find the unlock others miss</li> <li>Mission alignment: you believe in independent retail and can articulate why Faire matters</li> <li>Fluency in English &amp; German; additional European languages a strong plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>DACH market experience or German Speaker</li> <li>Any other European language skills</li> <li>Background in wholesale, retail, or brand partnerships</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Clay, or AI sales tooling</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>London, UK: the OTE pay range for this role is £89,500 to £123,000 per year.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.&nbsp;<br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. raw.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

title: Automation Lead
description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. Recruitment process Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered Founder conversation — 45 minutes Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent French & English is a prerequisite for this role

The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly.

What You'll Do

  • Train, tune, and test automatic target recognition and track management systems using the latest advancements in neural networks.

  • Develop multi-sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multi-target tracking) running onboard resource-constrained vehicles.

  • Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture.

  • Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation.

  • Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

  • Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience.

  • Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar).

  • Hands-on deep learning experience (training, evaluation, and deployment of neural networks for detection or classification).

  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Go, and/or Python.

  • Track record of taking algorithms from research to deployment on a real system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or deployed work in ATR, multi-sensor fusion, or distributed estimation.

  • Experience with EO/IR, radar, or RF sensor processing on aerial platforms.

  • Experience deploying ML models to embedded or edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization).

  • Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $180K – $260K • Offers Equity
